content.value: An ISP is granted a block of addresses starting with 190.100.0.0/16. The ISP needs to (13) [CO2] distribute these addresses to 3 group of customers:
i) $1 ^ { \mathfrak { s t } }$ group: 52 customers, each needs 128 addresses.
ii) $2 ^ { \mathrm { n d } }$ group: 40 customers, each needs 256 addresșes.
iii) $3 ^ { \mathrm { r d } }$ group: 100 customers, each needs 64 addresses.
How many addresses are still unallocated? Note down the network addressed of each group.
